# rustinion_process_watch_rule (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion process-watch rule: raises a compliance finding when no device in the group reports a running process whose name contains process_name (case-insensitive substring) within its last 30-minute snapshot. See process_watch.rs in the main repo for evaluation semantics.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group this process watch rule belongs to.
- `process_name` (String) Substring a running process's name must contain to satisfy this rule (case-insensitive, e.g. "nginx" matches "nginx: worker process").

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned process watch rule ID.
